description: This file contains PHP classes that implement an internal parse tree structure for the Smarty template engine. Specifically, it defines the Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_Template class, managing subtrees representing various parts of a parsed template, and provides methods for manipulating and converting the parse tree into executable PHP code.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_ParseTree_Template
classes.description: Represents the root node of the parse tree for a Smarty template, managing subtrees and converting them into PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the parse tree template class.

methods.name: append_subtree
methods.description: Appends a subtree to the current parse tree.

methods.name: append_array
methods.description: Appends an array of subtrees to the current parse tree.

methods.name: prepend_array
methods.description: Prepends an array of subtrees to the current parse tree.

methods.name: to_smarty_php
methods.description: Converts the parse tree into Smarty-compatible PHP code.

methods.name: getChunkedSubtrees
methods.description: Internal method to segment subtrees into chunks based on their mode for processing.
